utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina — could you come by around 9 a.m. with work gloves if you have them? I’ll have the rest ready on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can be there at 9 with my gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam. We’re still set for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could use an extra hand or two if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m free and happy to help on Saturday. Just tell me where to start on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Sam. I’ll assign you setup on the front porch, and I’ll send the exact timing and what to bring once I confirm the space layout.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m still gathering helpers, so if you’re free, I’d love your support.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I’ll be there on Saturday to help on the front porch. Just point me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. I could really use you at the front porch Saturday—I'll point you to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch — I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, we still need a few more hands. Can you come Saturday morning and help set up on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll greet folks and sort the easy fixes on Saturday, and I’ll keep asking around for anyone handy too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Sam — thank you! I’ll keep you on greeting folks and sorting the easy fixes, and I really appreciate you asking around too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send any handy neighbors your way for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you helping round up neighbors. I’ll keep everyone updated about the move to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep you posted on the exact setup tasks. We should be fine on the front porch, but I’m still sorting the timing and space.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I really appreciate it. I’m still trying to line up a few more helpers for Saturday, so just let me know what you need from me.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
